    The Marriage

    Dear Family & Friends,

    Warm greetings of Jai Somnath from Dr. Jashvantsinhji Fatesinhji Rathod and the late Dharmishthaba Jashvantsinhji Rathod, of Vadadla village, now living in Padra.

    With great joy, and by the boundless grace of Naganechiya Mataji, we announce the marriage of the son of our eldest son, Shri Pareshsinhji Jashvantsinhji Rathod, and A.Sau. Binaba Pareshsinhji Rathod —

    Chi. Avirajsinhji
    Chi. Bhargikunvarba

    Chi. Bhargikunvarba is the daughter of Surendrasinhji Mansinhji Vaghela and A.Sau. Ruchiba Surendrasinhji Vaghela of Vajiriya village (now in Vadodara). The marriage is fixed for Monday, Magshar Sud Pancham, Samvat 2083 — 14-12-2026.

    We warmly request you and your family to grace this auspicious occasion in person and bless the newlyweds.

    From the brothers and sisters

    Tahuko

    Fly, little bird, across the sky, with this invitation in your beak. If a mountain comes, cross it; if a temple comes, stop for darshan; if a river comes, take a dip. And when you meet our family and friends, tell them: please, please do come to our big brother’s marriage!

    Destiny’s pen has tied two fates with a single thread,
    and led two unknown paths to one destination.

    This blessed union of Aviraj and Bhargi is truly one of a kind;
    with love, tradition and values, their life will shine bright.

    The blessings of our elders will be the jewel of their life,
    and with the seven pheras as witness, a love for all lifetimes is bound.

    ॥ Jai Somnath ॥
